itens.titulo: Afghanistan marks 80 years at U.N. as Taliban are denied country’s seat
itens.resumo: As Afghanistan marks 80 years as a member of the United Nations, the country’s seat in the world body remains in limbo, with no clear path for the Taliban to gain recognition.

itens.resumo: A bipartisan House committee has launched an inquiry into Mercedes-Benz's Chinese shareholders, who together own about 20 percent of the company, and how much influence they have.

itens.titulo: VOA interview leads to arrest of Iranian activists' family members
itens.resumo: Sepideh Gholian, a civil rights activist and former political prisoner, says security forces arrested and tortured three members of her family in a bid to force her to surrender, after she spoke to VOA’s Persian-language program “Omgh-e Meydan” (“Depth of Field”).

itens.resumo_pt: Os pára-quedistas designados para a 11a Divisão Aerotransportada pararam de pára-quedas no Havaí em um exercício de entrada forçado conjunto como parte da rotação 27-01 do Centro de Prontos Multinacionais do Pacífico Conjunto.

itens.titulo: Report Shows Progress Toward DOW 2028 'Clean Audit' Goal
itens.resumo: The War Department has made significant progress toward its 2028 clean-audit goal, according to an annual audit report. "This is a really big deal for us," said Jules W. Hurst III, comptroller of the department.
itens.titulo_pt: Relatório mostra progresso em direção ao objetivo da DOW 2028 'auditoria limpa'
itens.resumo_pt: O Departamento de Guerra fez progressos significativos no sentido da sua meta de auditoria limpa de 2028, de acordo com um relatório anual de auditoria. "Isto é muito importante para nós", disse Jules W. Hurst III, responsável do departamento.

itens.titulo: National Guard Airlift Wing Begins Operation Deep Freeze Support
itens.resumo: The New York Air National Guard's 109th Airlift Wing deployed 75 airmen and five ski-equipped aircraft to support Antarctic research during Operation Deep Freeze.
itens.titulo_pt: Guarda Nacional Asa de transporte aéreo começa Operação de Frio Profunda Suporte
itens.resumo_pt: A 109a Asa de Transporte Aéreo da Guarda Aérea de Nova Iorque implantou 75 aviadores e cinco aeronaves equipedas com esqui para apoiar a pesquisa na Antártida durante a Operação Deep Freeze.
